# J-XXX — Signature journey

Stable ID; release/status; UC/PRD/persona/job links; starting context and verified goal.

## Screen-by-screen flow

Entry→state/SCR/component→user voice/touch action→agent allowance→feedback→next state. Show exact approval point and prepare/commit difference.

## Required variants

Ambiguous person/content, permission revoked, authentication, offline/provider failure, app update/stale semantics, partial/unknown result, interrupt/Stop/takeover, safe retry/undo. Exact adult respectful copy and return/focus behavior.

## Access and Figma

Nonvoice/non-audio, text scale, focus/switch/keyboard, no forced time/precision; exact frame names/prototype routes and privacy annotations.

## Evidence

EVAL oracle and failure conditions; human understanding tests, status unrun until evidence. Link policy/interface/task/gate and unresolved consequential choice.
